question: How has revenue changed over the last 90 days?
Which region generates the most revenue?
Which products sell best by revenue?

content: This is synthetic demo data, not real business performance. All revenue and average order values are in USD.
Use sales_metrics as the only fact source. Its measures must be queried with MEASURE(), not SUM() or AVG(). Group by the requested dimensions.
Revenue is total_revenue, order count is order_count, and average order value is average_order_value. Dates use the calendar day.
The data covers the last 90 days. A synthetic Europe discount around days 55-65 of the generated period creates a revenue dip.
